svg.title: Thesis summary · QLIKE reduction in the primary evaluation
svg.desc: Two contrasts, five versions/targets, two families; a common axis from minus three to plus three percent, with all clipped values marked.
svg.text: Thesis summary · QLIKE reduction in the primary evaluation
Common Y scale: −3 % to +3 %. Positive = lower loss after adding information. Primary window only.
Arrows mark points or CI limits outside the scale and print their actual values. Clipping is not presented as a result of ±3 %.
Whiskers = saved 95% CI of the difference × 100 / observed baseline loss; NOT bootstrap intervals of the ratio.
v1 uses 92 261 origins; other versions use 160 832. Horizons are distinct targets, not independent replications.
The complete, unclipped figure and exact values remain in comparison_v1_v4.svg and comparison_v1_v4.csv.
The compact scale supports comparison; adverse points and all out-of-scale limits remain visible through arrows.
